hypotheses.mechanism: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 introduced a timeout that causes payment calls to time out after 250ms, leading to increased error rate

cause.statement: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 deployment (d-581) introduced a 250ms timeout for payment calls

runtime_effect.statement: payment calls in checkout-svc time out after 250ms, causing retries to fail quickly

symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate exceeds 0.1 for 15s, triggering the alert

hypotheses.mechanism: payment-svc version 2.4.1 has a bug causing duplicate order_id entries, leading to payment failures

cause.statement: payment-svc version 2.4.1 deployment (d-579) introduced a bug with duplicate order_id entries

runtime_effect.statement: payment service returns HTTP 500 errors due to duplicate order_id entries

symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate increases due to payment service failures

hypotheses.mechanism: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 has a bug in the retry logic that causes excessive retries on payment failures

cause.statement: checkout-svc version 1.9.0 deployment (d-581) introduced a retry logic bug

runtime_effect.statement: checkout-svc retries payment calls up to 5 times with short timeouts, causing timeouts and 500 errors

symptom.statement: checkout-svc error rate exceeds 0.1 for 15s, triggering the alert

parsed.rationale: The evidence shows checkout-svc version 1.9.0 (d-581) was deployed with a commit (0d6ba14) that explicitly adds a 250ms timeout for payment calls. Logs confirm payment timeouts (log:7db2506518) and 500 errors (log:de694e9264) from checkout-svc. The metric (metric:1364a73bd4) shows error rate spikes at the exact time of the deployment. Payment-svc error rate (metric:e084a75703) is high but the root cause is the checkout-svc timeout, as the alert is specifically for checkout-svc error rate.
